header: What our editors published this month
subheadline: Working notes from the teams behind The Northstar Quarterly, Signal Weekly and the Lodestar archive. We publish them between the four print issues.

posts.title: Reading a paper twice, once for the data
posts.excerpt: Mira Kovac explains the second reading every quantitative paper gets, and the three checks that find most of what the first reading misses.

posts.title: Colour proofing 4,200 copies in one day
posts.excerpt: Lena Osei describes a press day in Vienna. Plate checks start at 07:00, the first clean sheets come by 09:30, and one page always needs a second pass.

posts.title: Permissions in five days, not five weeks
posts.excerpt: Hanna Lindqvist rebuilt the rights desk around one intake form. Every request now gets a decision within five working days.
